risks.title: Goodwill valuation and impairment
risks.score_rationale: Goodwill represents over $1.9 billion, or nearly 30% of total assets. The text explicitly states that changes in assumptions (discount rates, forecasts) could lead to a material impairment. The sensitivity of assumptions is highlighted as critical.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international operations
risks.score_rationale: Significant presence across multiple regions (EMEA, Latin America, Asia-Pacific). Although partially mitigated by local production, the risk is confirmed in the document with active hedging instruments and detailed sensitivity analysis.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on debt
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate swaps are in place on $1.4 billion of debt. The document details exposure to SOFR fluctuations and potential impact on financing costs, with significant gains/losses reclassified to earnings.

risks.title: Uncertain estimates in connection with acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes subjective estimates used to assess acquired assets and liabilities, directly impacting goodwill. The language underscores inherent uncertainty and the risk of post-acquisition adjustments.

risks.title: Exposure to raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: Significant purchases of steel, resin, containerboard, etc., without substantial hedging. The risk is mentioned but lacks quantitative details or mitigation strategies, making it moderate but real.

risks.title: Concentration risk on Ipackchem
risks.score_rationale: The Ipackchem reporting unit is the only one that underwent a qualitative test (Step 0) in 2024, indicating heightened scrutiny. Although not impaired, its separate treatment suggests perceived vulnerability.

ai_positioning.summary: The company GEF does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
